words.title: Forget a time frame
words.under: Choose some days. Jarvis lists what it learned and your chats from then - untick anything you want to keep, then tap Forget these. Nothing is removed until you approve the card, and for 10 minutes one tap on Undo puts it all back.
words.waiting: Waiting for your yes on the approval card. Nothing is removed until you approve it - saying yes out loud does not.
